# Pokédex Quality Checklist: Mobile Pokédex

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for Pokédex data accuracy, search and filter edge cases, mobile accessibility, and PokéAPI loading/offline resilience prior to task generation
**Created**: 2026-11-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Pokédex Data Accuracy

- [x] CHK001 Are all 18 canonical elemental types and all 6 defensive multiplier tiers (`0x`, `0.25x`, `0.5x`, `1x`, `2x`, `4x`) explicitly specified for both base species and alternate forms? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK002 Is the display rule for neutral (`1x`) defensive matchups unambiguously defined without contradiction between "clearly excluded or separated" in User Story 3 and grouped display requirements? [Ambiguity, Spec §US3-AS3, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Is the upper bound and visual scaling baseline for base stat progress bars (e.g., canonical `255` maximum per stat vs. relative scaling) explicitly defined in requirements? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK004 Are formatting and completeness rules defined for compound or special evolution triggers (such as friendship + time of day, gender-locked evolutions, held items, or known moves) and multi-branch chains like Eevee and Wurmple? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK005 Are inclusion/exclusion boundaries explicitly defined for species varieties outside regional, Mega, and Gigantamax categories (e.g., battle/cosmetic forms like Castform, Rotom, Deoxys, or Lycanroc)? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, Data Model §2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the canonical ordering rule for selecting the "most recent available English game entry" — and handling duplicate flavor text across paired game releases — explicitly documented? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK007 Are fallback requirements specified when a species or alternate form lacks shiny artwork, lacks a Hidden Ability, or has no English flavor text entry? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-006, §FR-009]

## Search & Filter Edge Cases

- [x] CHK008 Are search normalization rules specified for punctuation, apostrophes, hyphens, gender symbols, and diacritics in Pokémon names (e.g., `Mr. Mime`, `Farfetch'd`, `Flabébé`, `Nidoran♀`, `Porygon-Z`, `Type: Null`)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK009 Is the selection cap and user-facing behavior when attempting to select more than 2 elemental types in the `Filters` bottom sheet explicitly specified in `spec.md`? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, Data Model §3.1]
- [x] CHK010 Are combined-criteria rules unambiguously defined when a numeric Dex query (e.g., `#0025`) is entered alongside conflicting elemental type, generation, or collection-status filters? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [x] CHK011 Are `Filters` bottom sheet draft vs. commit semantics (dismissing via backdrop/swipe vs. tapping `Apply` vs. tapping `Reset`) specified consistently between `spec.md` and `data-model.md`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Data Model §3.1]
- [x] CHK012 Is the scope of the caught progress counter (`Caught X / Y`) explicitly clarified when search or filters are active (always full National Dex `Y = 1025` vs. filtered subset)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK013 Are empty-state messaging and recovery requirements defined separately for zero-match searches/filters versus an empty `Caught` or `Favorites` collection before the trainer tracks any Pokémon? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005, §Edge Cases]

## Mobile Accessibility & Ergonomics

- [x] CHK014 Is "readable contrast across all 18 elemental type badges" quantified in `spec.md` with an objective WCAG contrast ratio threshold (e.g., `>= 4.5:1` AA) matching `plan.md`? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, Plan §Technical Context]
- [x] CHK015 Are screen-reader announcement formats specified for composite widgets (catalog cards, stat bar name + numeric value, dual-type matchups, Caught/Favorite toggle state, and evolution triggers) for VoiceOver and TalkBack? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK016 Are maximum supported dynamic text scaling factors (e.g., up to 200% OS font scale) and text-wrapping vs. truncation rules specified for compact 2-column grid cards and filter chips? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK017 Are assistive-technology focus management and state-change announcement requirements defined when opening/closing the `Filters` bottom sheet or switching detail form/flavor selectors? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK018 Are non-color visual indicators specified for Caught/Favorite states, Hidden Ability badges, and base-stat tier differentiation so information is not conveyed by color alone? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]

## PokéAPI Loading & Offline Resilience

- [x] CHK019 Are distinct user-facing error and retry requirements specified for all external failure classes (offline, `404` not found, `429` rate-limited, `5xx` server error, and malformed payload) consistently between `spec.md` and the PokéAPI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, PokéAPI Contract §2]
- [x] CHK020 Is the cold-start offline requirement explicitly defined when the app launches for the very first time with zero cached catalog index versus relaunching offline with partial cache? [Completeness, Spec §US1-AS4, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK021 Is partial-cache behavior specified when a trainer attempts an elemental type filter offline for a type whose member list was never fetched while online? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-004, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK022 Are cache freshness/staleness expectations and local storage failure recovery requirements (e.g., corrupted collection data or failed local write when toggling Caught/Favorite) documented in requirements? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-012, Storage Contract §3]
- [x] CHK023 Are loading-placeholder and broken/missing artwork fallback requirements explicitly specified across catalog cards, detail hero views, and evolution chain thumbnails? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006, §Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria & Cross-Artifact Consistency

- [x] CHK024 Are `SC-001` ("under 5 seconds under normal network conditions") and `SC-007` ("without visual stutter") quantified with objective measurement conditions (baseline network latency and frame-rate target)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-007]
- [x] CHK025 Are deep-link routing requirements consistent when an incoming link targets an alternate form slug (e.g., `/pokemon/raichu-alola`) versus a base species slug (`/pokemon/raichu`)? [Edge Case, Conflict, Spec §FR-013, §FR-017, Navigation Contract §2]
- [x] CHK026 Do species ID bounds (`1..1025`), base-species collection semantics, and non-destructive pull-to-refresh rules align without contradiction across `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `data-model.md`, and `contracts/`? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
